row.team_price_text: Standard: pay-as-you-go, 5.5% platform fee on credits (usage-priced, no per-seat price)
row.evidence: OpenRouter's pricing table marks SSO/SAML as Enterprise only, and its docs say 'SCIM group mappings are available for organizations on Enterprise plans and require an active SSO connection.'
row.notes: New row. Usage-priced: Free (no platform fee, 25+ free models), Standard pay-as-you-go with a 5.5% platform fee, Business pay-as-you-go with an 8% fee, Enterprise via sales (fee discounts); no per-seat prices, so per-user fields are null. SSO/SAML is Enterprise only; SCIM provisioning is self-serve for Enterprise admins once one SSO connection is active (choose Okta, Entra ID or Custom SCIM 2.0) and uses a per-organization endpoint URL and bearer key shown once in the UI. IdP deactivation/deletion deactivates the org membership and the API keys the user created in the org; keys are not re-enabled on reactivation. IdP groups map to workspaces with Member or Admin roles. Okta and Entra connect through the admin's own SAML/enterprise app (no catalogue app found). The management API (Standard and above) lists org members and adds/removes workspace members, but has no user create/invite or delete endpoints. confidence is medium because the SCIM plan comes from docs while the pricing page states only the SSO gate.

plans.name: Free
plans.price_text: Free (no platform fee; 25+ free models, 50 requests/day)

auth.token_source: Settings > Members > SCIM Mappings > Enable SCIM provisioning (API key shown once; Rotate API key to replace)
auth.notes: No expiry is stated; after rotation the old key works only for a short grace period.

operations.notes: Docs describe Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate Users and Push Groups in Okta; PUT vs PATCH support is not stated. Reactivation restores the member but not their deactivated API keys.

deprovision.data_retained: Organization membership is deactivated and API keys the user created in the organization are deactivated across its workspaces; the user's personal OpenRouter account, personal keys and other organization memberships are unaffected.

roles.how: IdP groups pushed over SCIM are mapped to workspaces with a Member or Admin role (highest role wins); an IdP admin group set at activation grants organization admin.

limitations.text: Requires Enterprise plus an active SSO connection; self-serve activation needs exactly one active SSO connection.
API keys deactivated by deprovisioning are not re-enabled when the user is reactivated.

scim.notes: The SCIM endpoint URL is generated per organization and shown in Settings > Members > SCIM Mappings; its pattern is not published.

capabilities.notes: create_user false by absence: no member create/invite endpoint in the API reference.

endpoints.purpose: Bulk add organization members to a workspace
Bulk remove members from a workspace
Create a SCIM group-to-workspace role mapping
Bulk assign organization members to a guardrail

limitations.text: Members with active API keys in a workspace cannot be removed from it.
List endpoints return at most 100 records per page.

user_api.notes: Base URL from the OpenAPI servers block.

okta.notes: No OIN app found (okta.com/integrations/openrouter/ 404); docs use the admin's own SAML app with SCIM provisioning.

entra.notes: Docs describe an 'OpenRouter enterprise application' with automatic provisioning; no Microsoft Learn gallery tutorial was found.

google.notes: Google Workspace is a guided SAML option; SCIM setup offers only Okta, Entra ID or Custom SCIM 2.0.
